After the war, he dedicated himself to farming and, in 1975, wrote The One-Straw Revolution, expressing his concerns about Japan's modernizatiom Later, Fukuoka worked on projects to fight desertification and continued farrning into his eighties. Before researchers become researchers they should become philosophers. They should consider what the human goal is, what it is that humanity should create.
